find: it cannot show with particularity how two more years of classroom attendance for this small group would harm those interests
replace: it cannot show with particularity how exempting this small group from two more years of classroom attendance would harm those interests
reason: The original reverses the comparison. The State must justify refusing the exemption by showing the harm that granting it would cause.

find: which would trigger strict scrutiny regardless of \textit{Yoder}.
replace: which could trigger strict scrutiny if the exemption mechanism or the treatment of comparable conduct makes the rule not generally applicable. Comparability turns on whether a religious exemption would undermine the State's disease-control interests in a similar way to a medical exemption.
reason: Medical exemptions do not automatically require religious exemptions. General applicability turns on the nature of the exemption and whether the permitted conduct poses comparable risks to the asserted government interest.
